title: Reachable configuration code
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine, let $x$ be a finite binary input, and let $s,u\in\mathbb{N}$. The code $u$ is reachable at radius $s$ if it can be obtained from the code of the initial configuration of $N$ on input $x$ by zero or more steps of the one-step relation on configuration codes at radius $s$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the definition of the one-step relation or the configuration coding.
